items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The assassin bug makes two bite attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Ovipositor
items.notes:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target is infested with 1d3 assassin bug eggs, which immediately hatch into assassin bug maggots. At the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage per maggot infesting it. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills these assassin bug maggots. After this time, the maggots are too far under the skin to be burned.

If a target infested by assassin bug maggots ends its turn with 0 hit points, it dies as the maggots burrow into its heart and kill it. Any effect that cures disease kills all assassin bug maggots infesting the target.

items.name: Keen Smell
items.notes: The assassin bug has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Radiant Blast
items.notes: Radiant energy erupts from the blindheim's eyes in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) radiant damage and be blinded until the end of the blindheim's next turn. Creatures with the Sunlight Sensitivity trait have disadvantage on this saving throw.

items.name: Radiant Eyes
items.notes: While its eyes are open, a blindheim projects bright light in a 60-foot cone and dim light for an additional 60 feet. It sets the orientation of this cone at the end of each of its turns. All creatures that can see the blindheim have disadvantage on attack rolls while in the area of bright light and within 15 feet of the blindheim. Creatures with the Sunlight Sensitivity trait that can see the blindheim have disadvantage on attack rolls anywhere in the area of bright light.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The crab folk makes two claw attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the crab folk can automatically hit the target with its claw, and the crab folk can't make attacks with that claw against other targets. The crab folk has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

items.name: Limited Amphibiousness
items.notes: The crab folk can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged once every 24 hours to avoid suffocating.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The dire corby makes two claw attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

items.name: Dire Cacophony
items.notes: Any creature other than a dire corby that starts its turn within 60 feet of a dire corby and can hear it must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is unable to use the Dash action, cannot climb, or cast spells other than cantrips until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Keen Hearing
items.notes: The dire corby has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

name: Eye of Fear and Flame
languages: all languages known by any creature within 30 feet of it

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The eye of fear and flame's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The eye of fear and flame makes two claw attacks and uses its Gemstone Eyes.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Gemstone Eyes
items.notes: The eye of fear and flame shoots one of the following magical eye rays, choosing one target it can see within 90 feet of it. Eye of Fear: The target and up to four other creatures of the eye of fear and flame's choice within 10 feet of the target must each succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Eye of Flame: The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 44 (8d10) fire damage, and if it is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and does not ignite. A target that ignites takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to douse the fire.

items.name: Turn Immunity
items.notes: The eye of fear and flame is immune to effects that turn undead.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The giant makes two greatsword attacks and casts fog cloud.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (6d6 + 8) slashing damage.

items.name: Rock
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Petty Tyrant
items.notes: The fog giant shouts bloodcurdling threats at the creatures that serve it. Each medium or smaller ally of the giant within 120 feet of it that can see or hear it can use its reaction to make a melee attack.

items.name: Denizen of the Mist
items.notes: During its turn, the fog giant ignores the effects of fog cloud spells cast by it or other allied fog giants.

items.name: Keen Smell
items.notes: The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The forlarren's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The forlarren makes two claw attacks and one gore attack, or it makes three chromatic ray attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Gore
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Chromatic Ray
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) lightning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The forlarren has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Club
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: -1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 3) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Dart
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

items.name: Lurkers in Shadow
items.notes: Jermlaine are invisible to darkvision.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The jermlaine has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Vermin Friend
items.notes: The jermlaine can speak to and understand rats and giant rats.

items.name: Swarming Rush
items.notes: A jermlaine adds 1d4 to its weapon damage rolls while within 5 feet of another, conscious jermlaine.

items.name: Bite
items.notes:
Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and if the target is wearing metal armor or carrying a metal shield, the khargra attaches to that armor or shield. While attached, the khargra doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the khargra's turns, roll a d20. On a 10 or higher, the armor or shield takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed.
The khargra can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the khargra.

items.name: Earth Phasing
items.notes: Until the end of its next turn, the khargra can fly through nonmagical earth and stone. While doing so, it doesn't disturb the material it moves through. It can end its movement within earth or stone, but if it remains within earth or stone when this ability ends, it takes 14 (4d6) force damage and immediately moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

items.name: Opportunistic Hunger
items.notes: When a creature the khargra can see within 5 feet of it hits it with a metal weapon, the khargra can make a bite attack against that creature.

items.name: Iron Scent
items.notes: The khargra can scent the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: + -1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Blessing of Bountiful Generosity
items.notes: The killmoulis targets up to eight creatures within 100 feet of it that it can see. The next time a target finishes a long rest, it regains all spent Hit Dice and gains 10 temporary hit points.

items.name: Curse of Poor Hospitality
items.notes: The killmoulis targets up to eight creatures within 100 feet of it that it can see. The next time a target completes a long rest, it does not regain spent Hit Dice.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Blood Boiling Hex
items.notes: The mite places a hex on a creature it can see within 60 feet of it for 1 minute. If the mite is hidden, using this ability does not reveal its location. While the creature is affected by this hex, whenever it makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, it must roll a d6 and subtract the number rolled from the d20 roll. On any turn in which it suffers the effect of the hex, the target can attack an ally as a reaction, ignoring the effect of the hex when it does so. It can then ignore the effect of the hex until the end of its turn.

items.name: Vexing Presence
items.notes: While within 30 feet of a mite that can see it, a non-fey creature has disadvantage on Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The nettle lord makes 2 raking vine attacks.

items.name: Needle Volley
items.notes: The needle lord makes up to 1d6 needle attacks, but it cannot attack the same target more than twice during its turn.

items.name: Raking Vine
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 11 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The needle lord has two raking vines, each of which can grapple only one target.

items.name: Needle
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

items.name: Needle Defense
items.notes: Each time a creature makes a melee attack against a needle lord, it takes 2 piercing damage. A creature can choose to make an attack with disadvantage to avoid this damage.

items.name: Needle Volley
items.notes: The needle spawn makes up to 1d6 needle attacks, but it cannot attack the same target more than twice during its turn.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Needle
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Close Quarters Shooting
items.notes: The needle spawn does not suffer disadvantage on ranged attacks while within 5 feet of a hostile creature that can see it and isn't incapacitated, if the target of the attack is also within 5 feet of the needle spawn.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The norker makes one mace and one bite attack.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

items.name: Mace
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Defensive Rebuke
items.notes: If a creature within 5 feet of the norker makes a melee attack against it, the norker can use its reaction to cause 4 piercing damage to it.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The norker war leader makes one greataxe and one bite attack, and also uses Fight On, You Slugs.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Greataxe
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Fight On, You Slugs
items.notes: The norker war leader picks up to three allied goblinoids within 60 feet that can see it. The chosen creatures can each use their reactions to make a single melee attack.

items.name: Defensive Rebuke
items.notes: If a creature within 5 feet of the norker makes a melee attack against it, the norker can use its reaction to cause 6 piercing damage to it.

items.name: Barbed Tail
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Agile Flier
items.notes: Opportunity attacks against the screaming devilkin have disadvantage while it is flying.

items.name: Ceaseless Screaming
items.notes: Any creature other than a screaming devilkin that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more screaming devilkins and can hear it must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure the creature is incapacitated until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature suffers no effect.

items.name: Stunted Legs
items.notes: The screaming devilkin has disadvantage on attack rolls and all attack rolls made against it gain advantage while the devilkin isn't flying.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The xill makes four claw attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

items.name: Ethereal Jaunt
items.notes: As a bonus action, a xill can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

items.name: Poison Stinger
items.notes: The xill injects poison into one creature it hit with its claws this turn. The chosen creature must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, with disadvantage if the xill hit it more than once this turn, taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned this way.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Ygorl's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * Spell from Xanathar's Guide to Everything

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Ygorl makes three attacks: two with its scythe, and one with its Entropic Touch.

items.name: Scythe
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) necrotic damage. Any creature reduced to 0 hit points by this attack dies, with its body and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, exploding into a cloud of ash. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a wish spell.

items.name: Entropic Touch
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

items.name: Summon Slaadi
items.notes: Ygorl summons 1d4 + 1 death slaadi. A summoned slaad appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Ygorl, acts as an ally of Ygorl, and can't summon other slaadi. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Ygorl dies, or until Ygorl dismisses it as an action.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Ygorl teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

items.name: Entropic Aura
items.notes: Each creature that is not a construct or undead that ends its turn within 15 feet of Ygorl takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Ygorl fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Ygorl has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Scythe
items.notes: Ygorl makes one attack with its scythe.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: Ygorl uses its Teleport action.

items.name: Call the Void
items.notes: Each creature that is not a construct or undead within 30 feet of Ygorl must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw against the lord of entropy's attempt to unmake life, taking 42 (12d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Ygorl then regains a number of hit points equal to half the total damage taken by all affected creatures.
